title: Tranquility Spa Concierge
description: Turned a crowded service menu into a connected guidance, booking, intake, and staff workflow.
seoDescription: How an operations conversation became a working spa concierge connecting service guidance, booking, intake, staff operations, aftercare, and feedback.
role: Product strategy, systems design, and implementation
constraints: Recommendations had to come from an approved service catalog and exact duration matches rather than generic AI knowledge.
A non-technical business needed to update services and operate visits without rebuilding the concierge.
The guest's context needed to continue from recommendation through booking, intake, staff preparation, aftercare, and feedback.
problem: A crowded spa menu left visitors choosing by unfamiliar service names while staff had no connected path from guidance to visit preparation and follow-up.
solution: Built a concierge and staff workflow that filters a 20-service catalog, returns one eligible recommendation, carries it into booking and intake, and gives staff one place to run the visit.
result: The prototype demonstrated the complete guest and staff journey through working tools instead of a slide-only concept.
Twenty services remained manageable through one editable catalog and six shared booking groups.
The review surfaced the next production decision: replace or upgrade the conversation layer while preserving the operating system behind it.
deliveryHighlights: A guest-facing spa site, concierge, system tour, and live prototype that an owner can click through.
Airtable service catalog and staff interfaces connected to Make booking, intake, completion, aftercare, feedback, and alert scenarios.
A tested recommendation-to-booking path using DeepSeek ranking, Cal.com availability, and Tally intake with hidden booking context.
